about: David's player's margin (mw-ar5k42b.2, docs/audio-player-margin.md): no sound from outside a span (a verse or a section) is emitted more than `lead` seconds before its start or `tail` seconds after its end, judged at 50 dB under the voice's level. tests/e2e/recorded-voice-margin.spec.ts holds the player to these two numbers. `inside` is how far INTO the span its edges can be lost: the start heard up to inside.lead late (0.05: the latest of 360 plays was 46 ms, mw-ar5k42b.59; the spec fails a start later than lead, which would lose the span's own tone), the end stopped up to inside.tail early (the player stops END_SLACK before the end after a FADE). Seconds of the recording.

measured.when: 2026-11-14, src/speech/recordedVoice.ts as at e689536e6 (unchanged by this story), the Laptop under its own load (1-minute load 14.4-31.2)
measured.how: 30 plays a case at 1x and 1.25x, half on a fresh page and half by Play again: one verse with silence either side, one verse with none, a three-verse section with none at its edges; plus pause and resume, Next verse and a chapter's crossing, once each

browsers.webkit: not measured: Playwright's WebKit build needs libjxl.so.0.8 and libbacktrace.so.0, which Ubuntu 24.04 on the Laptop does not have, and the Laptop has no root to install its other libraries
